technical.observation: The FAQ confirms September 30, 2028 retirement for Basic/Standard/Premium and clustering by default. The creation, architecture, and clustering pages agree that RediSearch permits Enterprise or Non-clustered, excludes OSS, and caps Non-clustered at 25 GB. A Non-clustered cache may change to a clustered policy outside active geo-replication; OSS/Enterprise policies are fixed. The default 7.4 version selects modules at creation; 8.2 preview bundles all four on newly created supported in-memory tiers. The module-planning page treats NoEviction as a choice that can cause write errors at capacity.
technical.recommendation: Repair the vector-search teaching, alleged source conflict, question 42 and its answer. Distinguish Redis 7.4 and 8.2 preview, clustering requirements and the role of the eviction policy.
